remarks: Experience the Best of Lakefront Living in Mallorca! Imagine waking up to breathtaking lake and mountain views and enjoying a resort-inspired lifestyle year-round. Located within the highly sought-after gated community of Mallorca on Lake Mission Viejo, this exceptional two-bedroom residence boasts one of the community’s most desirable locations, with expansive 180-degree lake views enjoyed from nearly every room. The popular single-level Baroness floor plan offers an inviting open-concept design, beautifully remodeled with quality finishes and timeless style.
